plain: A formal ruling that settles a dispute

webster.text: The act of adjudging; the act or process of trying and determining judicially; as, a ship was taken and sent into port for adjudication.

more.text: A judicial sentence; judgment or decision of a court.

example.quote: This might as well happen in the case of two contradictory statutes; or it might as well happen in every adjudication upon any single statute.
